# Spookwerk

> Spookwerk is an app studio in the Netherlands building privacy-first iOS apps. This is the Dutch-market site; the main hub with app pages, support, and the blog is at https://spookwerk.app/.

## Pages

- [Home (Nederlands)](https://spookwerk.nl/): Dutch-language landing page.
- [Home (English)](https://spookwerk.nl/en/): English-language landing page.
